coordinate_system.blender_conversion: runtime/contract [x,y,z] -> Blender [x,z,y], matching the reviewed structural recovery pipeline

floor_interface.footprint_rule: exactly [cells_x*4.0, cells_z*4.0] centered on the placement origin
floor_interface.mating_edge_rule: the full boundary terminates exactly at each footprint plane; adjacent modules butt without gap, overlap, scale, or offset

edge_interface.rule: wall, doorway, end-cap, corner, junction, blocked-frame and portal visual wings use this one section; silhouette variation is allowed only outside terminal mating bands

doorway_open_interface.state_parity: intact, damaged and breached keep the same clear prism and mating interfaces

wall_family_interface.corner_and_junction_rule: each occupied wing is the exact rotation of the shared 4.0 x 3.2 x 0.2 edge section; internal geometry is a manifold union, never stacked coplanar wings
wall_family_interface.end_plane_rule: every wall_end or portal_edge mate is exactly at tangent +/-2.0 m (or +/-4.0 m for a two-cell module) with identity pivot and no socket offset

pillar_interface.rule: bearing faces contact the floor and shared structural top exactly; cosmetic damage may not move either contact plane or the placement pivot

ramp_interface.endpoint_rule: the center walking surface is exactly y=0.0 at z=-4.0 and y=0.55 at z=+4.0; both endpoint strips are flat and flush with their adjoining floor datum
ramp_interface.runtime_status: hold authoring and release until canonical procgen emits or explicitly consumes the +0.55 m endpoint transform; current deck placement is in 4.0 m increments

transform_contract.edge_world_position: cell_world_position + direction*[2.0,0.0,2.0] on the selected cardinal axis

variants.allowed_difference: authored damage only away from mating bands, clear prisms, floor/ramp endpoint strips, pivots and sockets
